title: terrain.forced_refresh_requested
description: M3 re-open (2026-05-13) M22 pathfinder forward-compat signal. Emitted by the per-tick dirty-region coalescer when `unupdated_areas > 0` has persisted for N consecutive ticks (default 60 @ 60Hz = 1 second). Tells the M22 pathfinder its incremental dirty-rect updates are falling behind and it should perform a full path-cost grid rebuild on the next tick.

reason.description: Why a forced refresh was requested. Currently only one reason; left as an enum so M22 can extend (e.g. `chunk_load_pressure`, `path_request_starvation`).

sustained_ticks.description: Number of consecutive ticks where `unupdated_areas > 0` before this signal fired.

threshold_ticks.description: Threshold the engine was watching. Configurable in future via `settings.terrain.forced_refresh_threshold_ticks`.
